name: Breezeline (formerly Atlantic Broadband)
notes: Internet-category dossier for Breezeline (same My Account as the tv dossier breezeline-cogeco-formerly-atlantic-broadband-346b05). Researched 2026-10-10 from public help.breezeline.com articles and the My Account page (no sign-in, no forms). Registration: account number from the bill plus service address or phone number, then a breezeline.net email address and password used for My Account, email, streaming TV and the My Breezeline app, so the identifier is email. The account page offers Want To Pay Without Signing In?, My Account Sign In, Recover Username, Reset Password and Create Account (guest lookup fields not described; family default kept). AutoPay is free by credit card, debit card or checking/savings (EFT), withdrawn on the statement due date. EcoSave is electronic billing (current offers: $10/month off for EcoSave + AutoPay from ACH, not modelled). Payment arrangement: Account Summary > click here in the delinquent balance section > choose a new pay date > Submit. Western Union walk-in payments cost $1.50. No online cancel flow (cancel_service unsupported online, inferred); customer service 1-888-536-9600. After cancelling: internet and breezeline.net email stop when processed; charges run to the end of the billing cycle (no proration) or until equipment is returned; 30 days to return equipment (charges appear at once and are waived on receipt); final bill within 30 days; no early cancellation fee. Late fee and plan prices not published.

cancel_service.note: Breezeline service isn't cancelled online; call customer service at 1-888-536-9600. There's no early cancellation fee, and rental equipment must be returned within 30 days.

help.title: Ways to pay your Breezeline bill
paragraphs: View and pay your bill in My Account or the My Breezeline app, or pay without signing in. To register, enter the account number from your bill and your service address or phone number, then create a breezeline.net email address and password; the same sign-in works for email, streaming TV and the app.
You can also pay in person at Western Union with your 16-digit Breezeline account number; each walk-in payment has a $1.50 service fee. New payments can take 24 hours to show in My Account.

help.title: AutoPay
paragraphs: AutoPay is free. On each statement due date your payment is withdrawn automatically from the checking account, savings account or credit card you choose. Enroll from Pay My Bill on the website or manage AutoPay in the My Breezeline app with your breezeline.net email address.

help.title: Set up a payment arrangement
paragraphs: Missed a payment? Sign in, open the Account Summary tab and select click here in the delinquent balance section. Choose a new pay date and select Submit.
steps: Select click here in the delinquent balance section.
Choose a new pay date and select Submit.

help.title: Canceling Breezeline services
paragraphs: There's no early cancellation fee. Internet, WiFi and your breezeline.net email stop as soon as the cancellation is processed, so save important email first. Cancelling mid-cycle means you're charged for the rest of that month; you can also cancel at the end of the cycle.

You have 30 days to return rental equipment. Equipment charges appear on your account right away and are waived once the equipment is received. Your final bill arrives within 30 days; AutoPay pays it automatically, or pay in the app, by mail or by phone.
